result.instructions: Tools for Jet HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on leave next week, and which absence requests are still pending?"; "List all employees whose contract ends in the next 90 days."; "Approve the pending holiday request of Maria Rossi.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jet HR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jethr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jethr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jethr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. jethr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jethr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the company's employees with the full record: name, fiscal code, work and personal email, job title and level, contract kind and dates, annual gross salary (RAL), manager, headquarters and custom fields. Contains personal data; for a lighter list use jethr_list_employee_overviews. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /public-api/v1/employees/.

as_of_date.description: Resolve the employee's data as of this date (yyyy-mm-dd) instead of today.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: jethr_create_absence_request
tools.title: Create a presence or absence request
tools.description: Create a leave, sickness, remote-work or other presence/absence request for an employee. WRITES to the company's HR records. codename is the request kind (from jethr_list_absence_policies); give start_date and end_date for day requests, or start_date + start_time + time_duration for hourly requests. send_notification=true makes Jet HR notify the people involved (approvers/employee) and needs confirm_notification=true; default false. Some kinds need extra fields (child data, trip data, sickness certificate): Jet HR answers with a validation error naming them. POST /public-api/v1/presence-absence-requests/.

codename.description: Request kind codename (from jethr_list_absence_policies), e.g. HOLIDAY.

end_date.description: Last day (yyyy-mm-dd); omit for a single day.

start_time.description: Start time HH:MM, hourly requests only.

send_notification.description: Notify the people involved (default false); needs confirm_notification=true.

confirm_notification.description: Must be true when send_notification is true: the user approved that Jet HR notifies the people involved.

sickness_justification_type.description: Sickness only: PUC protocol number or paper certificate.

puc.description: Sickness only: the PUC protocol number.

assisted_ssn.description: Fiscal code of the assisted person (kinds that need it, e.g. Law 104 leave).

donor_transfusion_center_ssn.description: Donor leave only: fiscal code of the transfusion center.

child_ssn.description: Child fiscal code (required for FEEDING, SICKNESS_CHILD_CHILD, SICKNESS_CHILD_INFANT).

trip_name.description: Trip policy name (required for TRIP_* kinds; see jethr_list_trip_refund_policies).

annotations.title: Create a presence or absence request

tools.name: jethr_update_absence_request
tools.title: Update, approve or reject an absence request
tools.description: Change a presence/absence request: dates, hours, note, or its status (APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING; give rejection_reason when rejecting). WRITES to the company's HR records; approving or rejecting is visible to the employee, and send_notification=true notifies the people involved (default false; needs confirm_notification=true). Only the fields you pass change. PATCH /public-api/v1/presence-absence-requests/{uuid}/.

rejection_reason.description: Reason shown to the employee when status is REJECTED.

start_date.description: New first day (yyyy-mm-dd); null clears it.

end_date.description: New last day (yyyy-mm-dd); null clears it.

start_time.description: New start time HH:MM, hourly requests only; null clears it.

time_duration.description: New duration HH:MM, hourly requests only; null clears it.

puc.description: Sickness only: the PUC protocol number.

assisted_ssn.description: Fiscal code of the assisted person (kinds that need it, e.g. Law 104 leave).

donor_transfusion_center_ssn.description: Donor leave only: fiscal code of the transfusion center.

send_notification.description: Notify the people involved (default false); needs confirm_notification=true.

confirm_notification.description: Must be true when send_notification is true: the user approved that Jet HR notifies the people involved.

annotations.title: Update, approve or reject an absence request

tools.name: jethr_delete_absence_request
tools.title: Delete a presence or absence request
tools.description: Permanently delete a presence/absence request (it disappears from the employee's calendar and balance). Cannot be undone; needs confirm=true. DELETE /public-api/v1/presence-absence-requests/{uuid}/.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved permanently deleting this request.

annotations.title: Delete a presence or absence request

tools.name: jethr_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense reimbursement request
tools.description: Create an expense reimbursement request for an employee (no receipt files; those are uploaded in Jet HR). WRITES to the company's records as a reimbursement request. amount is the EUR amount; amount_total is the amount in amount_total_currency (the same value for EUR). POST /public-api/v1/expenses/.

kind.description: Expense kind: FOOD, TRAVELS, KM, TELECOM, HOTELS, DEVICES, SERVICES, OTHER, CUSTOM.

amount_total.description: Amount in amount_total_currency (equal to amount for EUR).

subkind.description: Sub-kind of the expense, if the policy has one.

is_billed_to_company.description: The expense was billed to the company.

car_model_series.description: Mileage (KM) only: vehicle model and series.

car_cost_km.description: Mileage (KM) only: cost per km in EUR, e.g. 0.4521.
